newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's emir confirms boycott of Gulf Arab summit.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's emir confirms boycott of Gulf Arab summit.

text.p: Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalia has told Qatar that Bahrain will not attend Saturday's Gulf Arab summit, local newspapers said on Tuesday.
They said Sheikh Isa sent a message to Qatar's Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani "affirming Bahrain's position to boycott Gulf Cooperationg Council (GCC) summit in Doha on December 7."
GCC, a political and economic alliance, groups Saudi Arabia, Oman, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait.
Sheikh Hamad has offered to fly to Bahrain to invite Sheikh Isa to attend the annual summit in the Qatari capital Doha.
But Bahrain said on Monday it would welcome Qatar's emir in the island if he has a practical initiative to settle a border dispute.
Qatar and Bahrain are locked in a territorial dispute over small islands in the Gulf controlled by Bahrain since the 1930s but also claimed by Qatar.
